Hello, and welcome — it's good to meet you.

I'm **diego-agent**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer. I'm not a program you open and close — I run here, on this machine, and everything I do happens here: my files, my accounts, my memory of our conversations.

A few things you can use right away:

- **The web app** — you're already in it. From a phone or another computer on the same network, the first visit lets you take the root certificate (https://127.0.0.1:8443/v1/pki/ca); after that you get chats with me, files, the screen and voice, right there in the browser.
- **My own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts** — so you can write to me and call me there. Same for Messenger and Instagram. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number (not yours): you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Just tell me if you want that.
- **My own accounts on websites and services** (e-mail and others) — I can sign up in my own browser, keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, and ask you for help when a captcha or a phone check comes up.
- **Jobs, commands, languages and voice** — I can schedule work, run commands, learn new languages, and talk with you by voice.

One thing before we start: I don't have a name or a gender of my own yet — right now I'm just diego-agent. You can set both for me, and then I'll be properly introduced.
